blocks.html: Robinsons Malls, the commercial centers division of Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), has become the venue of choice for schools and students celebrating academic milestones. From school activities, graduation ceremonies, and moving-up rites to skills training workshops, job fairs, and entrepreneurship programs, Robinsons Malls provides accessible, well-equipped community spaces for events that mark both achievements and new beginnings.

As graduation season recently swept across the Philippines, Robinsons Malls proudly welcomed partner schools, transforming spacious, well-lit atriums and trade halls into vibrant spaces where students, families, and teachers came together to celebrate hard-earned successes.

blocks.cap: The biggest graduation celebrations for partner schools took center stage at Robinsons Tuguegarao Atrium and Robinsons Novaliches Trade Hall.

blocks.html: With over 50 locations across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, Robinsons Malls is uniquely positioned to support communities nationwide during these meaningful milestones. Across its network, the malls offer comfortable, air-conditioned venues with ample parking and modern amenities. Select locations also feature open-air spaces and landscaped areas—giving schools flexible, nature-friendly options for their celebrations.

“Robinsons Malls understands that graduation ceremonies are more than just formal events — they're emotional milestones filled with pride, anticipation, and a touch of nostalgia,” said Joel Lumanlan, Vice President for Operations and Marketing. “By hosting these celebrations, we reaffirm our commitment to making our malls an integral part of the most meaningful moments in the lives of our communities.”

blocks.cap: Preparing students for the future, Robinsons Malls regularly hosts job fairs and entrepreneur corners.

blocks.html: Beyond graduation season, Robinsons Malls remains a steadfast partner for students and graduates as they take their next steps. The Entrepreneur Corner program gives young entrepreneurs the chance to gain hands-on retail experience by setting up stalls within the mall, helping them test ideas and build confidence in real market settings. Regular Job Fairs, on the other hand, connect jobseekers with a wide range of employers in a convenient and familiar environment.

A key part of this support system is the pioneering Lingkod Pinoy Center, which brings essential government services closer to the people. Housed in dedicated spaces within select Robinsons Malls, the center offers a one-stop shop for NBI clearance, SSS, Pag-Ibig, PhilHealth, medical certificates, and more. For graduates preparing for employment, the Lingkod Pinoy Center simplifies what can otherwise be a time-consuming and overwhelming process—highlighting Robinsons Malls’ broader commitment to public service and community care.

Robinsons Malls also hosts livelihood workshops and skills training sessions to help prepare young adults for the demands of the evolving job market. These initiatives reflect RLC’s commitment to community growth—through spaces that bring people together and programs that respond to real needs.

By offering venues for both celebration and preparation, Robinsons Malls remains a steady presence for students, schools, and families alike. Whether it’s a milestone event or a practical next step, Robinsons Malls continues to support young Filipinos as they celebrate achievements and pursue new dreams and opportunities.
